paper: Speedup Techniques for Switchable Temporal Plan Graph, AAAI 2025
license: MIT (repository LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2024 ARCS Lab, Robotics Institute, CMU
setup_note: Submodule URLs in .gitmodules are SSH (git@github.com); for this environment they were locally rewritten to HTTPS, then `git submodule sync && git submodule update --init --recursive`. Upstream commit history was not rewritten.
run_command: ./build/simulate -p <path> -s <situation> -t 30 -a search -o stat.csv -n newpath.txt -b default -g all -h wcg_greedy -e true -i true
native_outputs: stat.csv (JSON content despite extension; upstream behavior)
adaptation_status: not yet adapted; native STPG consumes discrete oriented grid paths and situation JSON, while No02 has continuous 32-waypoint paths and continuous MPC timing. Mapping would require discretization and a new situation generator, and must be validated against the original switchable-edge semantics.
